name: Titus
title: Titus Caesar Vespasianus Augustus
summary: Titus Flavius Vespasianus was Roman emperor from 79 to 81 AD. A member of the Flavian dynasty, Titus succeeded his father Vespasian upon his death, becoming the first Roman emperor ever to succeed his biological father.
notes: Reign: 2 years, 2 months and 20 days. Titus was widely mourned. The Arch of Titus in Rome commemorates his conquest of Jerusalem and the spoils of the Temple. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Titus
